questions.topicReason: 考查固定搭配smile at sb.。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市普陀区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Many people are unaware ________ how much sugar they take in every day.
questions.topicReason: 考查固定搭配be unaware of，表示“没有意识到”。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市虹口区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: I had no idea what was wrong, but my sister seemed angry ________ me for some reason.
questions.topicReason: be angry with sb. 为形容词与介词的固定搭配。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市青浦区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Our future happiness depends ________ the choices we make today.
questions.topicReason: depend on 为动词与介词固定搭配。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海嘉定初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: In Chinese culture, horses are important symbols, which stand ________ speed and success.
questions.topicReason: stand for 表示“代表；象征”，考查介词固定搭配。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海奉贤初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: The famous writer will give a speech ________ reading habits to Grade Nine students.
questions.topicReason: 考查介词搭配，give a speech on/about a topic 表示作关于某主题的演讲。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海崇明初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: I’m now working as a volunteer and helping look ________ the cute pandas.
questions.topicReason: 考查动词短语搭配，look after 表示照顾。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海浦东初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: The result depends mainly ________ how well all members work as a team.
questions.topicReason: 考查固定搭配 depend on。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海金山初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: We can find real happiness ________ helping others and sharing kindness around.
questions.topicReason: find happiness in doing sth.为介词搭配，考查介词in与动名词结构的固定搭配。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海闵行初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Mr. Wang is a kind-hearted boss. He seldom gets angry ________ his workers.
questions.topicReason: get angry with sb.为固定介词搭配。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海青浦初三一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Three masked men broke ________ the Louvre Museum and stole some jewelry.
questions.topicReason: break into意为“闯入”，考查动词短语中的介词搭配。
